text: Monitoring alert triggered for web-03 port 443.
Elevated latency detected. p99 > 2s for 5 consecutive minutes.
Auto-scaling initiated. Spinning up web-04 and web-05.
Load balancer updated with new backend instances.
Root cause identified: expired TLS certificate on upstream proxy.
TLS certificate renewed and deployed across all nodes.
Latency returned to normal levels. p99 < 200ms.
Auto-scaled instances terminated. Back to baseline capacity.
